faults.detail: Wave 1 asks the child to place "1/2" on a 0-1 line with 2 gaps, and the title and sub say where it goes: "Aadha raasta" and "Do equal gaps ka middle mark".
"4 equal gaps mein pehla mark" gives the place of "1/4" (the same as the verified card key "1/4" for the first mark of 4 gaps).
The sub "4 equal gaps mein pehla mark" is wrong for the wave's other items "2/4" and "3/4", which are the 2nd and 3rd marks, not the first.

notes: Numbers and positions are correct: each wave's ticks match its denominator, so a child who counts marks instead of gaps lands in the wrong place, which covers the mix-up. The coach line "Dock ko drag karke mark pakdo" is dim grey but legible at both sizes.

faults.detail: Wave 3 asks the child to place "1/2" on a 2-gap line, and its title "Half mark" names where it goes.

notes: All unit-fraction positions are correct, and placing 1/8, 1/6, 1/4, 1/3, 1/2 on one 0-1 line shows a child who thinks a bigger bottom number means more where that belief goes wrong. Waves 1 and 2 put "1/6" and "1/3" on an eighths line and "1/8" and "1/4" on a sixths line, so these items fall between scaffold marks. That may confuse a class-5 child, but it is not a wrong fact, so it is not counted.

faults.detail: The coach text "Grid par khet banao" is drawn over the top row of grid cells, and the goal pill "Daud 1/4 kshetrafal 40 varg ikai" runs into the bottom edges of the "KSHETRAFAL —" / "GHERA —" / "DAUD 1/4" pills above it.

notes: Targets are correct and all fit on the 15x10 grid: area 40, then perimeters 26 (e.g. 8x5), 20 and 38 (12x7). The area-then-perimeter rounds with a live ghera counter catch a child who multiplies to get the perimeter. The p412 screen lays out cleanly.
